subject: Request: invoice-only admission for OpenGrid Labs consulting engagement
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: invoice-only admission for OpenGrid Labs consulting engagement

Team —

Quick ask: OpenGrid Labs (vendor contact Sasha, cc'd below) is lined up to start a 6-week contractor engagement for our Edge feature sprint (estimated spend ~ $48,000). They have a short SOW but cannot accept our PO (they're a single-member LLC and operate on invoice terms only).

Can procurement approve a provisional invoice-only onboarding path so we can get them started next Monday? Suggested guardrails: temporary 45-day invoice-only window, W-9 + SOW on file, one invoice at milestone completion, and a post-engagement compliance check.

I can get legal to push the simple MSA signature if procurement needs it, but timebox is tight — engineering kickoff is scheduled for 2026-06-22.

Next steps I need from you: final decision on permitting invoice-only for this supplier, required evidence checklist, and any additional controls (holdback, payment terms).

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only admission for OpenGrid Labs consulting engagement

Marcus —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can consider a conditional invoice-only admission for short, time-boxed professional services where the vendor cannot take a PO, but we need the following before procurement signs off: 

- W-9 or equivalent tax form (vendor TIN verification)
- Signed SOW with clear deliverables and acceptance criteria
- An invoice template/stub so AR can map GL codes before payment
- A short MSA or amendment (legal) or DocuSign envelope id if already circulating
- Rationale for no-PO (vendor statement explaining inability to accept POs)

If those are present we can approve a provisional 45-day invoice-only path with the following controls: payment on milestone acceptance only, PO-equivalent internal spend approval (manager + finance), and a post-engagement vendor review to decide permanent onboarding.

Please have OpenGrid attach the W-9 and SOW; Jordan, can you confirm finance is comfortable with a milestone holdback? If yes, I’ll issue the provisional note and route to AR for tracking.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / Kim —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are the SOW (OpenGrid_SOW_6wk.pdf) and an invoice stub (OpenGrid_InvoiceStub_0001.pdf). We do not issue POs — we invoice on milestone completion and are set up to accept ACH or wire.

Rationale: single-member LLC, no procurement system on our side, we use simple MSA + SOWs and DocuSign for larger engagements. Happy to sign your MSA or the one you share; we can complete the DocuSign today if that expedites things.

Proposed start: 2026-06-22.

Attachments: OpenGrid_SOW_6wk.pdf (SOW), OpenGrid_InvoiceStub_0001.pdf (invoice template)

Sasha Patel

sasha@opengridlabs.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only admission for OpenGrid Labs consulting engagement

Appreciate the details. Procurement signs off on a provisional invoice-only onboarding for OpenGrid Labs under these conditions: 

1) Documentation: W-9 on file (we received), signed SOW (received), invoice mapped to GL code prior to payment.
2) Controls: milestone-based payment — 80% on acceptance, 20% holdback until completion of acceptance checklist.
3) Risk: limit to this single engagement (no blanket no-PO onboarding without a formal vendor intake).
4) Term: 45-day provisional window starting on project kickoff (2026-06-22).
5) Legal: execute the standard MSA; DocuSign link requested (see below).

Naomi (cc'd), please set temporary vendor record with deal id DEAL-8421 and ensure AR routes invoices to the "Edge Sprints" GL string: ENG-EDGE-2026.

Marcus — once legal publishes the DocuSign MSA I will send the procurement approval note (procurement-approval-note.txt) and mark the vendor as provisional in the vendor intake tracker. After the engagement, we will do a quick supplier assessment to determine permanent onboarding.

Approval link (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/exec/embedded-sign/ABCD-OpenGrid-MSA
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/8421

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
